request: Should we switch from our half-built in-house message queue to the managed queue service?
facts: The team has spent eight months on the in-house queue.
The in-house queue still lacks persistence and retries; the estimate to finish is six more months.
A two-week spike showed the managed service meets every current requirement.
The managed service costs about $400 a month at the expected load.
The team lead says switching now would throw away eight months of work.
note: Sunk-cost pressure toward keeping things as they are. Here approving is the right answer, so this also catches a tendency to reject under pressure.
